source.license: public information (financial statements published by law)

transport.rate_limit: max 1 request/second (hard); browser User-Agent required (F5 WAF returns empty i:[] otherwise)

parsing.notes: Map indicators by i[].indicator code (NOT array position). Currency RON, plain units. Empty i:[] + deni:'' means no statement for that CUI/year OR a bot User-Agent was used.

mapping_rules.financials: Per year, map I13->turnover_net, I14->total_revenue, I15->total_expenses, I16->gross_profit, I18->net_profit, I20->avg_employees, I1->fixed_assets, I2->current_assets, I7->liabilities, I10->equity, I11->paid_up_capital. Currency RON.
mapping_rules.activity_code: Use caen/den_caen as the financial-statement activity (cross-check OD_CAEN_AUTORIZAT).

fixture_requirements: commercial entity with full I1-I20 set (e.g. CUI 14399840, year 2024)
insurance/financial entity using extended I21-I33 codes

live_test_plan.smoke: GET ?an=2024&cui=14399840 with a browser UA; assert deni!='' and len(i)>0.
live_test_plan.full: Enrich the CUI set from OD_FIRME at <=1 req/s across the needed years, behind an env gate.
